title: CTAM internal API v1 response envelope
description: Common wrapper for every /internal/ctam/v1 response. 'data' is deliberately permissive here; validate it against the resource schema for the endpoint as a second step.

cycle_id.description: Null only when the request is rejected before a cycle is bound, such as an authentication failure.

module_id.description: The authenticated caller. Null when authentication itself failed.

data.description: Resource payload, or null on error.

errors.description: Empty on success. Never contains a bearer token.

message.description: Operator-facing and redacted. Must not echo a token or an absolute host path. The walker has no minLength, so non-emptiness is expressed as a pattern.

resource.description: The resource the error is about, such as 'stormcells.current' or 'cells.history'.

pointer.description: For forbidden_path and invalid_patch, the rejected operation path exactly as submitted.

limit.description: For request_too_large, the limit that was exceeded, in the unit documented in internal-api-limits.md.
